name: tmcra-local-memory
description: Automatic cross-session and cross-tool project memory for Codex through the owner-local TMCRA runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Continue project work across Codex sessions and supported agent tools.
interface.longDescription: Recalls owner-global and current-project evidence before each Codex response, then stores user and assistant messages as separate source-attributed records in the owner-local TMCRA runtime.
defaultPrompt: Check whether TMCRA local memory is connected for this project.
Explain which TMCRA scopes are active in this Codex session.
